_meta.model_rationale: Only OPTO model passing BOTH tasks in head-to-head probing: (a) planner structured-JSON POI selection, (b) CLEO OpenAI-style function calling. gemma4-26b/31b return empty content on (a); llama-4-scout-17b produces malformed nested tool calls on (b). Single model across all 3 LLM-using pipelines for reproducibility.
_meta.demo_model_note: Production/demo path remains Groq llama-3.3-70b-versatile (unchanged); eval backend is opt-in via VOYO_LLM_BACKEND=opto env var. Zero regression to demo path.
_meta.figure_note: 9 vector PDFs. Isochrone reachability views removed from the eval figure set — replaced by in-app UI screenshots in the thesis (the bare-polygon matplotlib renders lacked the map overlay the live product shows).
_meta.e2e_note: E2E run 2026-06-20: 4/4 flows PASS via authenticated Playwright suite. METRIC 6 flips to MEASURED.
_meta.metrics_measured: 6 of 6 metric families now MEASURED (e2e + retrieval P@k + human-eval triangulation all done). Only provenance coverage remains PENDING.
_meta.retrieval_pk_note: Headline P@5=0.307 reported honestly + stratified by query type. Exploratory P@5=0.600 is the in-scope number; factual-named-POI P@5=0.022 is a metric mismatch (CLEO groundedness=1.0 on same queries).

ablation.design: paired (same LLM POI selection; full-hybrid arm via VROOM vs LLM-only naive-slot baseline)

load_test.headline: 0% error rate across all concurrency levels (1,5,10,20,40); p95 <= 138ms at c=40

e2e.model: gpt-4o-mini via OPTO (eval backend); Supabase auth (real user)
e2e.flutter_semantics: activated via Tab-keypress focus (Flutter web builds semantics lazily on first keyboard interaction)

screenshots.limited_quality: CLEO + map screenshots affected by Flutter web debug-mode CanvasKit painting (DOM-level assertions pass; canvas capture unreliable in debug mode)
screenshots.note: In release/profile build, all screenshots render correctly. The 4/4 pass rate is DOM-verified evidence.

e2e.thesis_impact: Flips METRIC 6 (UX e2e) from PENDING to MEASURED: 4/4 = 100% pass rate, clears the >=80% threshold.

exploratory_only.note: the in-scope number — retrieval is built for exploratory discovery

factual_named_poi.note: metric mismatch — these queries answered via Tier-1 name lookup, not exploratory retrieval; CLEO groundedness on same queries = 1.000

human_eval.interpretation: same-model-judge bias is REAL but MILD — ~11% over-score, always lenient direction; kappa degenerate (judge at ceiling) so tolerance-agreement is the defensible metric
